children.value: sadā tyāgī sadā'sakto jīvanmukta iti sthitaḥ

lokānāṃ prāṇināṃ ājavaṃ javībhāvā ūrdhvādhomadhyagatibhiḥ
parivartāstatprayuktāḥ prodvegāśca tajjño'pi
sarvaṃ sarveṇa sarvatra sarvathā sarvadaiva hi
pāpasya hi bhayālloko rāma dharme pravartate
ye vajrasārāḥ sudṛḍhā dṛśyante te kṣayaṃ gatāḥ
tatsaṃbhavati dehasya bhāve cābhāva eva ca
yo jīvati gatasnehaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate

yadupagataḥ sugataḥ padaṃ pradhānaṃ
yadapagato'dhruvatāṃ nṛpaśca kaścit
